create_tree_add: create a function that adds two or more pytrees element-wise
create_tree_sub: create a function that subtracts one pytree from another element-wise
create_tree_vdot: create a function that computes the inner product between two pytrees
create_tree_norm: create a function that computes the vector norm of a pytree with configurable order
create_tree_clip: create a function that clips all tensors in a pytree to a specified min and max range
